title: Decomposing calcium carbonate
caption: CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂, ΔH = +178 kJ mol⁻¹. The products are higher in energy than the reactants, so energy must be supplied continuously: limestone is heated to about 900 °C in a lime kiln.
alt: Reaction profile with CaCO₃ at the bottom, a high hump, and CaO + CO₂ at a higher level than the start.
description: Products CaO + CO₂, 178 kJ mol⁻¹ higher.
